verdict.rationale: Docs explicitly describe automatic failover/retry to other providers on failure (docs-3), configurable provider ordering/fallback with `order`, `only`, `sort` (docs-9, docs-29), per-provider timeouts to trigger fast failover (docs-10), and even automatic retry with system credentials when BYOK fails (docs-13). This directly covers automatic retry policies for transient provider errors. Missing for 10: no independent/hands-on confirmation of retry behavior in production, and no explicit documentation of configurable retry counts/backoff intervals distinct from provider ordering.
